newsitem.title: USA: Va. North Anna 2 nuke seen at full output Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Va. North Anna 2 nuke seen at full output Tuesday.

text.p: The 909 megawatt (MW) North Anna 2 nuclear power plant is set to resume full electricity production Tuesday after it synchronized with the power grid Saturday, the operator Virginia Power Co said Monday.
The Mineral, Va., unit tripped off line November 12 to repair a main electrical generator problem.
The neighboring 911 MW North Anna unit 1 was operating at full power, a company spokesman said.
Dominion Resources, parent of Virginia power, owns 88.4 percent of the units and Old Dominion Electric Co-operatives holds 11.6 percent.
